highlights.reason_zh: Codex 与 Claude Code 会话可在本地统一复核，但命令输出和导出视频仍需按敏感数据处理。
highlights.reason_en: Codex and Claude Code sessions can be reviewed locally in one view, but command output and exported video still require sensitive-data handling.

highlights.reason_zh: Littleguys 把多种本地 agent 的状态、审批和例行任务放进可安装控制台；adapter 权限边界仍要逐一验证。
highlights.reason_en: Littleguys puts status, approvals and routines for several local agents into an installable control surface; adapter permission boundaries still need separate validation.

highlights.reason_zh: ESP32 物理桥接降低 iPhone 真机 agent 实验门槛，但跨应用可靠性和安全停止尚无独立复现。
highlights.reason_en: An ESP32 physical bridge lowers the barrier to real-iPhone agent experiments, but cross-app reliability and safe stopping lack independent reproduction.

highlights.reason_zh: QGIS 已禁止向主仓库提交 AI 辅助代码；贡献者需立即遵守，但更广泛影响仍要看实际执行和其他项目是否跟进。
highlights.reason_en: QGIS now bans AI-assisted code contributions to its main repository; contributors must comply now, while broader impact depends on enforcement and adoption elsewhere.

coverage_zh: 35 个固定入口首次抓取成功，Microsoft Research 超时后重试并读完；固定入口最终 36/36 完成。本轮新增 4 条事件，完成 Iris-3B 的 7 天复核；召回自检补录 QGIS 政策。未出现新的稳定模型/API 发布。Microsoft Research 新文章晚于截止 22 秒；Maia 300 页面只有日期，无法证明早于 15:59:38Z，均留待下轮。
coverage_en: Thirty-five fixed monitors succeeded on the first capture; Microsoft Research timed out, then succeeded on retry and was reviewed, completing 36/36. The run adds four events, completes the Iris-3B seven-day review and recovers the QGIS policy through recall audit. No new stable model or API release appeared. A Microsoft Research item was 22 seconds after cutoff, while Maia 300 exposed only a date and could not be proven earlier than 15:59:38Z; both remain for the next run.
